description:
Thomson G1 (Thompson White) Dragon Fruit Cutting / Plant (Selenicereus guatemalensis)

Named in honor of California Rare Fruit Growers (CRFG) co-founder and pioneering pitahaya researcher Paul H. Thomson, the Thomson G1 (also known as Thomson Guatemalan-1 or Thompson White) is a legendary, heavy-yielding dragon fruit variety derived from Selenicereus guatemalensis.

This vigorous, dependable grower produces exceptionally large, robust fruits that can reach up to 2 pounds (900g). The exterior boasts an eye-catching bright pink skin adorned with vibrant lime-green fin tips, enclosing a thick rind that peels away easily from the pulp. Inside, you'll find crisp, snow-white flesh offering an aromatic, refreshingly sweet tropical flavor profile that makes it a standout for fresh eating and juicing.

A dream cultivar for both commercial growers and backyard orchards, Thomson G1 features very thick, sturdy three-sided stems equipped with small thorns. It is fully self-fertile / self-pollinating, putting on a stunning nocturnal show of giant, fragrant white blooms that set fruit reliably on their own without requiring manual cross-pollination.
